A.summary: A combines a track-free L2 ground plane, closely matched FPGA expansion pairs and broad power feeds with local regulator copper. Correct the 0.051 mm zone-to-edge clearance, two 0.150 mm drill-wall gaps and the R40 via issue, then confirm the USB impedance build before ordering.

B.summary: B has continuous core-power distribution, short regulator loops and zero open connections. Its USB pair makes two transitions per main path, a FIFO trace crosses an L3 void, and 29 vias enter SMD lands with filling and capping disabled.

C.summary: Refilling clears 534 saved-fill clearance errors but leaves 153 open connections and four intersecting-zone errors. The FIFO clocks, EEPROM bus, expansion pairs and I/O bank regulator circuits have missing connections.

D.summary: D has the strongest nominal USB cross-section and provides ground beneath much of the expansion routing. Its FIFO D0 uses nine vias, its inner tracks interrupt the ground reference, and its five core-supply patches rely on additional routing.

human_guess.why: A tunes the entire expansion bus toward a common length while giving the mirrored regulator and shunt circuits repeated local copper shapes and the USB shell its own shield regions. This circuit-specific treatment is the strongest authorship clue in the four layouts.
